definitions.definitionEn: A guarantee that a certain outcome or obligation will be fulfilled; security.

If evicted by someone with a superior claim (paramount title) they were also required to hand over other real estate of equal value in recompense. It has now been replaced by personal covenants and the covenant of warranty.

A deceased person who becomes reanimate to attack the living.
An apathetic person.
A human being in a state of extreme mental exhaustion.

example.en: After working for 18 hours on the computer, I was a zombie.
example.ja: 18 時間コンピューターで働いた後、私はゾンビになりました。

definitions.definitionEn: An information worker who has signed a nondisclosure agreement.
A process or task which has terminated but has not been removed from the list of processes, typically because it has an unresponsive parent process.
A computer affected by malware which causes it to do whatever the attacker wants it to do without the user's knowledge.
A cocktail of rum and fruit juices.
A conscripted member of the Canadian military during World War II who was assigned to home defence rather than to combat in Europe.
Marijuana, or similar drugs.
A hypothetical being that is indistinguishable from a normal human being except in that it lacks conscious experience, qualia, or sentience.

meaning: (心霊) ゾンビ(生死者又は不死者)になる

definitions.definitionEn: (fictional) To turn into a zombie (a member of the living dead or undead).
To take control of (a computer) in order to use it covertly and illicitly.

example.en: These trojans can zombify your machine.
example.ja: このトロイの木馬は君の機械を分解できる

meaning: 帯の;地域(地区)に分けられた

definitions.definitionEn: Divided into zones.

definitions.definitionEn: Extremely fatigued.

example.ja: 18 時間校正を行なった後、私は完全に裸にされました。

definitions.definitionEn: Deeply asleep.

example.en: I must have been really zonked. They said it took fifteen minutes to wake me up.

To move rapidly

(used with in or out) to manipulate a display so as to magnify or shrink it
Representing a humming sound
Suggesting something moving quickly
Suggesting a sudden change, especially an improvement or an increase

meaning: 急ぎ過ぎだ

definitions.definitionEn: To go by too quickly.

example.en: Our time together has zoomed by.
example.ja: 私たちの時間は縮まってきました。

meaning: 拡大画像やクローズアップするためにズームレンズの焦点距離を増加させる

definitions.definitionEn: To increase the focal length of a zoom lens in order to obtain a magnified image, or a close-up.

example.en: The camera operator will zoom in on the subject for a close-up shot.
example.ja: カメラのオペレーターは被写体にズームインします。

definitions.definitionEn: To manipulate a display (such as a computer screen) so as to make the image larger.

example.en: You can zoom in on the map to get a better view of the city.
example.ja: 地図上にズームインして、街をより良く見ることができる。

meaning: ある特定の対象や対象にすぐに焦点を合わせます

definitions.definitionEn: To quickly focus on a particular subject or object.

meaning: ズームレンズ(焦点距離を自由に変えられるレンズ)

definitions.definitionEn: A lens containing a mechanical assembly of inner lenses, allowing the focal length to be changed rapidly.

meaning: ズームレンズの焦点距離を小さくするために、画像のサイズを小さくするか、幅を広げるかします

definitions.definitionEn: To decrease the focal length of a zoom lens in order to obtain a reduced magnification of the image, or a wider-angle view.

example.en: The director asked to zoom out for a wider shot of the landscape.
example.ja: 院長は、より広範囲な風景の撮影のためにズームアウトするよう求めた。

definitions.definitionEn: To manipulate a display (such as a computer screen) so as to make the image smaller and possibly less detailed.

example.en: You can zoom out on the screen to see the entire document.
example.ja: 画面上にズームアウトすると、ドキュメント全体が表示されます。
